releaseNotes:
• 🛡️ Built-in AdBlocker & Privacy Shield: Blocks intrusive ads, video popups, and trackers in floating browser. One-tap shield toggle in URL bar.
• 🎵 Background Audio Playback: Play YouTube videos, podcasts, and web music in background even when window is minimized to bubble or screen is locked.
• 👻 Ghost Mode (Click-Through Overlay): Semi-transparent window allows all touches to pass through directly to underlying games or apps, with a floating top pill to exit anytime.
• 📥 Media & Video Downloader: Automatically sniffs video/audio playback on web pages with a 1-tap download button saving directly to system Downloads and Gallery.
• 🪟 Dual Floating Windows: Support for opening multiple independent floating windows simultaneously for true dual multitasking.
• 🔦 Sidebar Flashlight Tool: 1-tap torch toggle directly from the floating sidebar dock.
• 📱 All-Apps Floating Launcher: Search and launch ANY installed Android app into a floating window directly from the sidebar.
